Maya: Need a quick lock on speaker order + demo smoke test plan for next Tuesday's webinar. Can we finalise by EOD?
Jules: Speakers confirmed: Priya (bench), Tom (live demo). I can host the intro. Greenroom 11:40 PT, stage 12:00 PT.
Priya: Benchmark arc: one slide for hypothesis, one slide with concrete numbers (cost per 1k tokens + p95), one slide with recommended knobs. Keep it 4m.
Tom: Demo will be two-pass: 1) cached cost-flow, 2) cold start latency. Ops please note we need a warm-up window of 6m before show.
Ben: Registration form routing: hidden `lead_tier=trial|interest`. If `trial` then tag `priority:high` in CRM and push to #sales-live. Also capture `timezone` for SDR follow-up.
Jules: Can we also add `security_review=yes|no` so AE gets flagged?
Ben: Yep added. Also creating two separate post-webinar flows: trial leads -> demo SDR queue, general leads -> nurture sequence.
Tom: Ops: what's the rehearsal endpoint? I need to run the smoke script.
ops-bot: Rehearsal endpoint: `https://rehearse.redwood-infer/api/run?env=staging&model=rw-demo-2026`. Pre-warm token path: `/prime`. Timeout set to 40s.
ops-bot: Suggested priming commands:
```
curl -X POST https://rehearse.redwood-infer/prime -d '{"model":"rw-demo-2026","input":"Prime: summarize product in 10 words"}'
curl -X POST https://rehearse.redwood-infer/run -d '{"model":"rw-demo-2026","input":"Shorten to 2 bullets"}'
```
Priya: I'll attach the exact prompt templates and dataset name to the shared slides.
Jules: Proposed concise run: 11:40 greenroom; 12:00 quick intro 2m; 12:02 benchmark 4m; 12:06 demo 10m; 12:16 customer vignette 6m; 12:22 Q&A 12m; 12:34 CTAs + routing 6m. Total 40m.
Maya: Schedule looks good. Rehearsal 30m tomorrow 10:00 PT. Speakers upload slides to drive by 6pm. I'll send invites.
Tom: I'll run smoke tests at rehearsal start. If p95 > 500ms switch traffic to `rw-demo-2026-quant`.
Ben: CTA draft: "See how Redwood shrinks inference cost and keeps latency predictable  request a hands-on trial". Posting for edits.
Jules: Minor wording tweak suggested, posting in thread.
Maya: Thanks  if slides + form hidden fields are in place by 6pm we lock the run.
